itemized.in_kind_convention: not applicable, and this is the FIRST filing in this chunk whose form even offers the choice. This is the NEWER unversioned 2022 blank, whose Schedule A and Schedule B both carry a fifth printed column headed 'In-Kind' with a checkbox on every row. EVERY ONE of the 30 checkboxes (15 per schedule) is UNTICKED, and there is no monetary entry to attach one to, so the monetary-only and monetary-plus-in-kind conventions are identical at 0.00 on both sides. The Amount and In-Kind cells were cropped TOGETHER AS ONE BLOCK down the whole grid, per the standing warning that this blank prints its checkboxes about half a row higher than the amounts they belong to — the render confirms that offset is real on this filing (each box straddles its row's lower rule), which is exactly why a tick must never be mapped to a row by vertical position alone. Here it changes nothing, because none is ticked.

THE SAME CHUNK CONTAINS BOTH REVISIONS AND THEY ARE NOT CHRONOLOGICAL: this filing (reviewed 4/18 and 4/20/22) and the Diamond 4/11/22 filing (reviewed 4/18 and 4/20/22) carry the plain revision, while the Gardner and Gordon April filings (reviewed 4/4/22) and the Graves 3/31/22 filing (reviewed 3/31 and 4/4/22) carry the HOLD/#1/#2 revision — so the LATER-reviewed batch uses the OLDER-looking form. Neither blank is 'the 2022 form'; each filing must be read on its own. ⚠ WHAT THIS FILING PRINTS FOR OFFICE, QUOTED AND NOT ADJUDICATED: the cover's Office box is HANDWRITTEN in cursive and reads exactly — Commission Seat "B" — with the filer's own quotation marks around the letter B, no 'Utah County' prefix, and no other office text on the document. index.csv carries office 'County Commission' (no seat) for this filing.
